table.retrieve:
SELECT
	GD.Batch,
	GD.Expiry,
	GD.GCode,
	Stock = GD.CurrQty,
	dbo.item.icode,
	dbo.item.customicode,
	dbo.item.name, 
	localitemname = dbo.item.localitemname,
	dbo.item.manfcode, 
	dbo.item.packunits,
	dbo.item.purprice,
	SalePrice = dbo.item.saleprice, 
	dbo.Manufacturer.name,
	Packing = (SELECT dbo.itempacking.name FROM dbo.itempacking WHERE dbo.itempacking.packcode=dbo.item.packcode),
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,
	dbo.item.restricted,
	dbo.item.icatcode,
	dbo.item.iccode,
	dbo.item.packcode,
	dbo.item.itemalertcode,
	itemalerttypecode = (select ia.itemalerttypecode from itemalert ia where ia.itemalertcode = item.itemalertcode),
	dbo.item.isizecode,
	dbo.item.istylecode,
	dbo.item.icolourcode,
	dbo.item.iyarncode,
	dbo.item.isleevecode,
	dbo.item.ifabriccode,
	dbo.item.ibrandcode,
	dbo.item.ipartcode,
	dbo.item.oldpartcode,
	dbo.item.genericcode,
	dbo.item.location,
	itempartno = (select itempart.name from itempart where itempart.ipartcode = dbo.item.ipartcode),
	transitstock=item.transitstock,
	BGColor = (SELECT IA.BGColor FROM ItemAlert IA WHERE IA.ItemAlertCode = dbo.item.itemalertcode)
FROM	
	dbo.item, 
	dbo.Manufacturer,
	GodownDetail GD
WHERE
	dbo.item.Active = 1 and
	dbo.Manufacturer.manfcode = dbo.item.manfcode and
	dbo.item.ICode = GD.ICode

ORDER BY gd.batch, gd.expiry, dbo.item.name
